conviction_note: The quarter's volumes, sales and realised prices were pre-released on 14 Oct, the stock rose about 5% that day and has run up 27% in 20 sessions with Brent, so what is left for 29 Oct is cash flow and net debt, the dividend and a small chance of a North Sea guide raise. All three lean slightly positive and none is sourced as a number the market has not seen. The findings sum to +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.13 (p_up 52 x abs 3.2). The gap is the pre-release and the run-up pulling p_up to 50; it is not a disagreement about sign.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 trading update: net production North Sea 85,364 / Kurdistan 54,914 / West Africa 2,488 boepd; sales North Sea 94,732 / Kurdistan 28,058 boepd; realised North Sea oil 99.6, gas 122.9, NGL 62.1, Kurdistan oil 38.5 USD/boe; Q3 dividend paid USD 39.2m; Norwegian tax paid USD 136.4m; Côte d'Ivoire sale closed (USD 48.0m cash + 7m Panoro shares); Vår Energi swap closed (USD 20.3m net cash)
2026 North Sea production guidance raised to 85,000 boepd; quarterly dividend NOK 0.375 held at the same level for the fifth quarter; net debt USD 552.9m at end-Q2
DNO's offer for Capricorn Energy declared final at USD 5.214 and not increased after Genel's higher offer with 39.1% irrevocables, so the roughly USD 396m acquisition is effectively off

new_in_release.expect: Record revenue of roughly USD 1.0bn (my arithmetic from the pre-released volumes and prices: about USD 0.90bn North Sea, about USD 0.10bn Kurdistan). Derivable, so it should be flat against a sell-side bar that already models it.
Strong. North Sea sales ran about 0.86 MMboe ahead of production and USD 68m of divestment cash came in, so net debt should fall well below the USD 553m of end-Q2. Up.
Probably held at NOK 0.375. A raise is possible now that the Capricorn cash is not being spent; DNO raised its dividend at the Q2 2024 and Q2 2025 prints. Slight upside skew.
North Sea production averaged about 86.3k boepd over nine months against a guide of 85k, so a small raise is possible. Kurdistan guidance is unknown and depends on security. Slightly up.
Possible MtM and settlement loss on the gas collars (calls written at USD 99/boe against USD 122.9 realised). Small and negative.

findings.finding: The pre-released Q3 volumes and prices imply record revenue of about USD 1.0bn, up roughly 30% q/q (Q2: USD 760.5m), with Kurdistan back at 54.9k boepd net from 0.3k.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock took the trading update itself: up about 5-6% on 2026-10-14 (E24 'Oljeaksjer opp på Oslo Børs'; Yahoo close 20.18 -> 21.44). Results days after a trading update moved +0.65% (Q1 2026), +1.99% (Q2 2026) and +2.61% (Q3 2025).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The volumes and prices were disclosed on 14 Oct and the stock rose about 5% that day, which is exactly what the tape would show if the market had absorbed it. Sized at 0 on the pre-release rule.
findings.independence: E24, 2026-10-14, reported DNO up about 5% on the update: https://e24.no/bors/nyheter/a/305878

findings.finding: Q3 cash generation should cut net debt sharply from USD 552.9m. North Sea sales of 94,732 boepd ran ahead of production of 85,364 (about 0.86 MMboe of overlift against a 1.36 MMboe underlift at end-Q2), and USD 48.0m (Côte d'Ivoire) plus USD 20.3m (Vår swap) of cash came in, against USD 136.4m of tax and USD 39.2m of dividend paid.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed USD 289.5m of free cash flow and a USD 237m net debt reduction, and the stock rose 1.99% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The inputs are public but the net debt figure is not. If the market had fully extrapolated it, the post-update run-up (+13% from 21.44 to 24.24) would track Brent alone, and it roughly does, so most of this is priced. What is left is that the overlift supports cash more than EBIT, and a note keyed on EBIT can miss that.
findings.independence: The Q2 interim report gives the end-Q2 underlift of 1.36 MMboe and net debt of USD 552.9m: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/attachment?messageId=679563&attachmentId=330916

findings.finding: The quarterly dividend has been held at NOK 0.375 for five quarters while DNO chased Genel and Capricorn. It declared its Capricorn offer final and lost on 28 Sep, so the roughly USD 396m of acquisition cash stays on the balance sheet going into the first dividend decision since.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend raises coincided with +8.80% (2024-08-15, 'Hikes Dividends') and +9.31% (2025-08-21, 'Hikes Dividends'). Prints with the dividend held moved -0.85% to +2.61%.
findings.why_not_priced: A raise is not announced and DNO says it 'continues to rigorously evaluate a pipeline of opportunities', which argues for keeping cash, so the base case is a hold. The finding is the upside tail: a raise would land on a line that has moved this stock about 9% twice. Kept small because it is an inference about a board decision.
findings.independence: The Q2 release confirms the dividend held at 'the same level as the previous four quarters': https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679563

findings.finding: North Sea net production averaged about 86.3k boepd over Q1-Q3 (88,647 / 84,912 / 85,364) against a 2026 guide of 85,000 boepd, so a modest raise or a firming at the top end is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 85k raise came with the Q2 2026 print (+1.99%). Q4 only needs about 81.5k to meet the guide, so a raise would be small.
findings.why_not_priced: The nine-month run-rate is public arithmetic, so a raise of 1-2k boepd would be expected rather than a surprise. It mostly lands inside what is already guided, hence small.
findings.independence: The Q3 volumes come from the trading update: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684039

findings.finding: About 30% of DNO's post-tax gas exposure for H2 2026 is collared with written calls at USD 99/boe, and Q3 realised gas was USD 122.9/boe, so the hedge line should show a settlement and MtM loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history. This is the first quarter where realised gas sits well above the call strike.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic sits in a Q2 note and on a post-tax notional, so the loss is likely a few USD million. It is immaterial against roughly USD 1bn of revenue, hence a fraction of a point.
findings.independence: The Q3 realised gas price comes from the trading update: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684039

outside_window.finding: Genel's competing scheme for Capricorn (Tawke partner) is expected to complete in Q4 2026, subject to Egyptian approval. A change in DNO's Tawke partner is not inside this window.

baseline_tension: Mild. The findings lean slightly positive against a priced lean of -1.36, which is the 27% 20-day run-up term, and the run-up was earned mostly on the trading update and on Brent, so most of the good news is already in the price.
language_note: E24 (Norwegian) dated the market's reaction to the 14 Oct trading update: DNO up about 5% ('DNO stiger rundt 5 prosent'). The English wires carried the update but not the reaction.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: DNO publishes its NewsWeb releases in English only, and no Norwegian-language preview or consensus was found.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released revenue finding moved from +0.2 to 0.0.
'You were right about the number and too small about the move' (median move 3.1% on pre-released periods): abs_move_pct moved from 3.0 to 3.2. p_up stayed at 52.
